in_hebrew.name: נטליה
in_hebrew.meaning: מתנה של אלוהים, ילדה נוצרייה יפה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: נטליה היא שם שמקורו במילה העברית 'נתן', שפירושה 'לתת'. היא קשורה למושג נתינת מתנה מאלוהים. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים ומשמש כסמל למתנה האלוהית של ישוע המשיח. היסטורית, השם שימש בקרב הקהילות היהודיות והנוצריות כאחד.

in_greek.name: Ναταλία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ναταλία προέρχεται από τη λατινική λέξη 'Natalia', που σημαίνει 'Γέννηση'. Σχετίζεται με την εορτή των Χριστούγεννων και τη γέννηση του Ιησού Χριστού. Στην αρχαία Εκκλησία, το όνομα αυτό ήταν σύμβολο της πνευματικής αναγέννησης και της νέας ζωής που προσφέρει ο Χριστός.

in_latin.name: Natalia
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Natalia originates from the Latin word 'natalis', meaning 'birthday' or 'Christmas'. It is associated with the celebration of the birth of Jesus Christ. In the early Christian Church, the name symbolized the spiritual rebirth and new life offered by Christ. Historically, Natalia was used to commemorate the martyr Natalia of Nicomedia.

in_english.name: Nathalia
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nathalia, derived from Hebrew and Greek roots, signifies 'gift of God' or 'Christmas'. It originates from the Hebrew word 'natana', meaning 'to give', and the Greek 'Natalia', meaning 'birthday' or 'Christmas'. Historically, Nathalia was used in Christian tradition to commemorate the birth of Jesus Christ and symbolize spiritual rebirth. The name represents new life, hope, and divine gift.

In Eastern Europe, it gained prominence due to its association with the legend of St. Nicholas of Myra. In Western European folklore, the name Nathalia was believed to bring good fortune and joy. In Christianity, it symbolizes the powerful and enduring presence of goddesses, reflected in the scores of churches, cathedrals and other religious sites dedicated to St. Natthali or the Lady of Nativity.

It is believed to be a symbol of both the physical and spiritual light that continuously emerges from darkness. Nathalia signifies a refusal to be defined by circumstances and a choice to keep moving forward despite adversity. It is a reminder of the importance of inner strength and faith, and the power of the divine grace to guide us in our journey through life.
